packageRules.description: Never auto-update vendored Proton SRP code — manual re-vendor only

Gate @protontech/drive-sdk bumps behind manual dashboard approval — 0.15.x+ is blocked upstream by the @protontech/crypto ^2.0.0 peer dep shipping bare .ts source (TS5097). See closed PRs #9 (0.15.0) and #34 (0.15.1). Re-checked 0.17.3 on 2026-06-23: still blocked — peer dep unchanged, dist still does require('@protontech/crypto/subtle/hmac.ts'), and @protontech/crypto@2.0.1 still publishes raw .ts via its exports map (no main/types/dist). Unblocks only when @protontech/crypto ships compiled JS + .d.ts. Isolate in its own PR, never automerge.
